predicate_sql: bdc_investment_identifier IN ('Common Equity', 'Total Equity Investments') AND COALESCE(instrument_description, '') = ''

evidence.quote: The only rows with identifiers Common Equity or Total Equity Investments have no instrument_description and fair values of 3,962,000 (2023-06-30), 3,777,000 (2023-09-30), 6,173,000 (2023-12-31), 9,239,000 (2024-03-31), 8,480,000 (2024-06-30), 9,137,000 (2024-09-30), 8,259,000 (2024-12-31), and 6,755,000 (2025-03-31). Each amount equals the quarter's full residual or the subtotal component of it.

rationale: These are labeled equity subtotals, not investee positions. The detailed equity positions are already present, so summing these rows double-counts the equity section. The exact identifier and missing-detail guard avoid issuers whose legal names contain the word Total. COALESCE(instrument_description, '') = '' matches both frames: mid-build Layer C sees '' (staging fills empty string) while the published CSV frame round-trips '' to NULL; the original IS NULL form was inert in production (reauthored 2026-09-02).
